name: Being Envious
overview: Scripture reveals that envy is a corrosive force that damages the inner being, described metaphorically as 'the rottenness of the bones' in Proverbs 14:30. A heart aligned with God's truth fosters life and peace, whereas envy fosters spiritual decay and unrest. Believers are called to seek God's kingdom and righteousness first (Matthew 6:33), trusting in His unchanging nature (Malachi 3:6) to provide for their needs, rather than succumbing to the destructive works of the flesh, which include envy (Galatians 5:19). The Word of God, powerful and discerning (Hebrews 4:12), guides believers to respond with gentleness (Proverbs 15:1) rather than anger, promoting a heart free from envy and full of godly peace.
